verdicts.reason: Both candidates put the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline, which breaks the reading order. Both also have pill text that is too small to read, and both float the CTA off the text column's left edge. A keeps the three pills equal in size and aligned to the column, with the peach circle sitting behind the CTA much as in the original. B moves the peach circle onto the yellow one, which muddies the top-left decoration. Its pills are ragged: Honey Rosemary starts left of the column, and Cucumber Mint is smaller and sits higher, with even tinier text. B's pills are also jammed against the CTA.
